heading: Monday
text: Partly cloudy northwest, more sunshine southeast, becoming partly sunny. More afternoon clouds with a rising chance of scattered late afternoon showers or a thunderstorm over New York and southern Ontario, spreading over the Green Mountains in the evening. Rain heaviest north of Route 4 after dark. Highs in the low to mid 80s, upper 80s in the broad valleys south and east. Winds light, mainly south less than 10 mph.

heading: Monday Night
text: Scattered showers or thunderstorms becoming likely north, with a rising chance south. Rain tapering off around midnight, after in the southeast. Lows in the upper 50s to low 60s.

heading: Tuesday (Primary Day)
text: A few lingering early morning showers otherwise mostly cloudy then clouds begin to break up becoming partly sunny by the afternoon. Less warm, highs in the mid 70s to low 80s. West winds shifting northwest, picking up to 8-10 mph.
